recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. Any future harmonization of OperationDefinition with ElementDefinition profile/targetProfile naming would require a separate work-group design change.
issue_request: FHIR-44690 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested changing opd-3 from ValueSet/resource-types to ValueSet/all-resource-types; Jira comments also required fixing the targetProfile definition and clarifying how OperationDefinition differs here.
initial_application: Commit 5d68211faaefeb2476f0484dd6155adb5e01abbd had already changed only the opd-3 expression to all-resource-types. The active OperationDefinition source still described targetProfile as Reference/canonical-focused and only mentioned the literal Resource type, leaving concrete resource parameter types and OperationDefinition-specific profile semantics unclear.
additional_context: FHIR-26411 established that OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile should apply to inline resources, and FHIR-39345 updated opd-3 for that decision using the older resource-types ValueSet. The Zulip thread that led to FHIR-44690 clarified that Resource and concrete resource types such as Patient are all intended to be valid with targetProfile and that OperationDefinition intentionally uses targetProfile where ElementDefinition would use type.profile. FHIR-I minutes approved the all-resource-types correction.
reconciliation: Updated source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml to say resource parameter types can use targetProfile to identify allowed profiles for inline resource parameter values, and to explicitly describe this as OperationDefinition-specific behavior corresponding to ElementDefinition.type.profile rather than ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile.
source_changes: source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml: revised OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile short and definition to cover any resource type, allowed profiles, and OperationDefinition-specific inline-resource profile semantics.

related_jiras.note: Established that OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile applies to inline resources.
Updated opd-3 for inline resource use but used ValueSet/resource-types, which FHIR-44690 later corrected to all-resource-types.
